copy: Group tags together and choose how each group matches. Groups can require every tag, or just one of them.

explainer.title: Two ways a group can match
explainer.anyCopy: A character needs at least one tag from the group. Use this to widen your results.
explainer.allCopy: A character must have every tag in the group. Use this to narrow your results.
explainer.sample: Example: a group with "Remove Bind or Remove Paralysis", plus a second group with "Orb Boost", finds characters that cure one of those two and also boost orbs.

counts.show: Show how many characters have each ability
counts.hide: Hide how many characters have each ability
counts.label: Character counts

help.title: How this filter works
help.groups: A group is a set of abilities you want together. Add as many groups as you need; a character must satisfy every group to appear in the results.
help.operators: Each group matches in one of two ways: "Has any of these" needs one tag from the group, "Has all of these" needs every tag in it.
help.turns: Abilities that last a number of turns get a minimum-turns selector, so you can ask for the ability only when it lasts long enough.
help.counts: The number under an ability is how many characters carry it. In the captain section it counts only characters that carry it as a Captain Ability.
